name: timed-remote-challenge-loop
display_name: A timed exchange with a remote engine, where nothing advances except on a real response
description: A visitor starts a session against a remote engine, submits, receives generated content, submits again, and receives an outcome. A clock and a progress indicator run alongside. The rule that makes it honest: every visible state change — clock start, progress marker, outcome — is a consequence of a successful response, never of the click that requested it.

contract.outcome: on a successful start response: the session's own content is rendered from the response, the clock starts, and the working area comes into view. On failure: an honest offline message, the clock does NOT start, and no progress marker is set.
must_not: start the clock before the response
contract.evidence: gauntlet_new.js header + POST /round path; live C.1 (clock read 19:59 one second after a real 200)

contract.outcome: the visitor's text is sent; on a successful response the generated reply is rendered verbatim into its own region and EXACTLY ONE progress marker is set as a side-effect of that response
must_not: allow a marker to be toggled by the visitor
contract.evidence: the manual-toggle handler was deliberately deleted in the P4 rebuild (EXPERIENCE_PLAN Journey C.4); live C.2 asserts exactly one marker set

contract.outcome: on a successful response the outcome and its reasons are rendered; the remaining markers complete, and the completion marker that depends on beating the clock is set ONLY if time genuinely remained at receipt
contract.evidence: EXPERIENCE_PLAN Journey C.3; live C.3 (three markers, progress reads 100%)

contract.outcome: while a request is in flight, a running elapsed counter is shown — not a silent spinner
contract.why: the calls are slow by nature (measured 8–23 s live). A wait with no evidence of progress is indistinguishable from a broken page.
contract.evidence: gauntlet_new.js header comment; measured latencies in verify_live_2026-07-26.txt

_SCHEMA_DELTA: degraded_states / data_contract / latency_envelope are fields the draft DDL does not have — see HARVEST_01 §3.

degraded_states.when: the engine returns an error status or the request fails
degraded_states.outcome: a plain honest message naming the engine as unavailable, AND an explicit reassurance that the visitor's typed text is preserved
degraded_states.evidence: live run, attempt 1: 'The AI opponent is offline — try again later. Nothing was lost; your text is still here.' — a real degraded render captured in the verification log, then the retry succeeded
degraded_states.note: The upstream flakiness itself is bugs_open/083 (the handlers discard the reason). The PATTERN is unaffected: the degraded state is part of the contract and was exercised for real.

degraded_states.when: the proxy in front of the engine rewrites error bodies
degraded_states.outcome: the client's offline path must key on the status the visitor's browser actually receives
degraded_states.evidence: Cloudflare replaces origin 502 bodies, so the engine returns 503 deliberately (gauntlet_dead_cta RUNBOOK; gauntlet_new.js header)

data_contract.session_state: held in page memory for the session only; never persisted client-side, never invented
data_contract.input_cap: {{binding.max_chars}} characters per submission, enforced client-side and server-side
data_contract.rendering_rule: content returned by the engine is rendered as-is; the client never re-derives or supplements a field
data_contract.cross_origin: the page's origin must be allow-listed by the engine — a browser-real check, not exercisable from a script that bypasses CORS

latency_envelope.consequence: acceptance checks for this pattern REQUIRE a wait/poll. The platform's browser-runner asserts 300 ms after the last step (internal/adapters/browserrunner/run_checks_action.go:199 stepDelay, assertion in runInteraction at :493) with a 120 s run deadline — so a correct page fails the plan's own gauntlet_position_flow / gauntlet_defend_flow checks. Fix the harness, never the page: placeholder text would pass with the engine switched off.
